kind: historical FILM H reference matched exactly to frozen ALFRED pilot50; no new simulation or state rescoring

valid_seen.evaluator_definition: Pinned ALFRED goal methods selected from the authoritative trajectory task_type, applied to saved terminal event metadata and object-state history.

valid_unseen.evaluator_definition: Pinned ALFRED goal methods selected from the authoritative trajectory task_type, applied to saved terminal event metadata and object-state history.

aggregation.score_source: existing per-episode official_record and official success, never native FILM success
aggregation.path_weighting: efficiency=expert/max(expert,executed); expert-length-weighted success and per-episode GC

perception_setting_provenance.threshold_evidence: arguments.py use_sem_seg block sets with_mask_above_05=True and score thresholds0.8; historical run wrapper enables --use_sem_seg

comparability_limits: Exact task/repeat identity, scene, task parameters, selected high-level goal and low_actions match; some FILM preprocessing adds a terminal high_pddl NoOp/End and additional root fields, explicitly recorded. This is a paired historical method reference, not a controlled memory ablation.

FILM used its full ALFRED-trained language planning, semantic search, navigation, and interaction policy. Current system uses a pretrained multimodal model with incremental memory and different control logic.
Even where released depth/mask checkpoints are shared, score thresholds and perception postprocessing/navigation settings differ.
FILM approximate pose/horizon/action-feedback flags are true; current actor uses action odometry and yaw/horizon proprioception. Input/measurement assumptions therefore differ.
Historical FILM actions were bounded by max_steps1000/max_fails10; current pilot additionally caps60 LLM decisions. Latency/token budgets are not matched.
Recorded steps_taken is the historical executor count, not an independently recounted primitive trace in this audit; it is preserved without normalization.
No aggregate from the complete historical splits was extrapolated to pilot50; all metrics derive only from the50 exact matched official records.
This audit did not rerun agents, load model checkpoints, deserialize pickle files, or invoke simulator goal predicates. Existing official scores and provenance hashes were verified.
